headline: Godrej Properties adds ₹6,000 crore luxury project
summary: Godrej Properties signs development agreement for a 2.5-acre prime land parcel in Marine Lines, South Mumbai, with estimated revenue potential of ₹6,000 crore.

headline: Stocks to Watch Today: Som Distilleries, Power Grid, RPG Life in focus
summary: Som Distilleries rallies 10.6% after MP High Court order; Power Grid wins major transmission bids and RPG Life jumps 5.2% on merger news.

headline: Sun Pharma secures global rights for PCSK9 inhibitor
summary: Sun Pharma enters exclusive licensing deal with LIB Therapeutics for lerodalcibep outside US and China, targeting a $3.7 billion market.

headline: Le Lavoir sets up Bengaluru laundry facility
summary: Le Lavoir Limited has entered a five-year lease agreement for a 2,400 sq. ft. facility in Bengaluru to expand its laundry processing and warehousing capabilities.

headline: AC, TV and appliance prices to rise up to 8% from Oct 1
summary: Prices of air conditioners, televisions, and home appliances are set to increase by up to 8% from October 1, ahead of the festive season, according to a newspaper report.

headline: BN Agrochem updates website domain
summary: BN Agrochem Limited changed its official website domain from bn-holdings.com to bnagrochem.com effective September 28, 2026.

headline: Morepen files first US ANDA for Sitagliptin
summary: Morepen Laboratories submitted its first US ANDA for Sitagliptin Tablets, marking a strategic shift from API manufacturing to integrated CDMO services and finished dosage development.

headline: Radico Khaitan enters four UK airports
summary: Radico Khaitan becomes the first Indian spirits company to enter duty-free shops at Heathrow, Gatwick, Manchester and Birmingham. The move targets 170 million annual passengers.

headline: Nomura keeps Vi at Neutral on roaming plan
summary: Nomura maintains a Neutral rating on Vodafone Idea as the telco introduces free international roaming across select plans. The move aims to boost customer stickiness and target premium users.

headline: Rupee opens at 95.88 against the dollar
summary: The Indian rupee opened at 95.88 against the US dollar, compared to the previous close of 95.8125, reflecting a marginal weakening in the domestic currency.

headline: Embraer picks Mahindra for IAF transport bid
summary: Embraer selected Mahindra & Mahindra as a partner to bid for the Indian Air Force's 60-aircraft KC-390 Millennium transport programme.

headline: AC, TV, washing machine prices to rise 5-8% from Oct 1
summary: Electronics makers including Voltas, Bluestar, Havells, and Whirlpool are set to hike prices of ACs, TVs, and washing machines by 5-8% starting October 1, per newspaper reports.

headline: Cyient DLM targets 25-30% electronics growth
summary: Cyient DLM targets 25-30% growth in electronics manufacturing, backed by an order book reported at 5x its current revenue, signalling strong pipeline visibility.

headline: Linde India secures Sanand land for chip-packaging gas facility
summary: Linde India has acquired land in Sanand to set up a new gas facility supporting semiconductor chip-packaging operations, expanding its footprint in India's growing chip manufacturing sector.

headline: IRDAI plans tighter checks on insurance mis-selling
summary: IRDAI is planning stricter measures against insurance mis-selling and aims to give buyers greater access to pricing information and insurer track records, according to a newspaper report.

headline: Suntory in talks to buy up to 15% stake in Allied Blenders
summary: Suntory is reportedly in talks to acquire up to 15% stake in Allied Blenders & Distillers, with discussions also covering distribution and manufacturing synergies.

headline: Govt plans to identify 10,000 textile exporters
summary: The government plans to identify 10,000 textile exporters and aims to transform districts into dedicated export hubs, according to a newspaper report.

headline: ITC targets eastern India dairy with value-added products
summary: ITC is focusing on eastern India's dairy segment by tailoring value-added products to meet regional consumer demand, signalling a strategic push in the category.

headline: Lupin gets tentative FDA nod for Apixaban suspension
summary: Lupin Limited received tentative U.S. FDA approval for its novel Apixaban Oral Suspension, offering a liquid alternative for patients unable to swallow tablets.

headline: CleanMax shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 8,593,725 CleanMax shares changing hands on NSE at ₹1,320.30, with combined value of ₹1,134.63 crore.

headline: Titan's automatic watch business targets ₹350-400 crore
summary: Titan is betting on India's growing appetite for mechanical watches, with its automatic-watch business expected to reach ₹350-400 crore this fiscal, up from ₹265 crore last year.

headline: Epigral CMD targets ₹5,000 crore revenue by FY31
summary: Epigral's CMD outlined capacity scale-ups as the primary driver to achieve the company's ₹5,000 crore revenue target by FY31.

headline: Govt launches anti-dumping probe on pentaerythritol imports
summary: The Indian government has initiated an anti-dumping investigation into imports of pentaerythritol from Russia, signalling scrutiny of potential unfair trade practices in the chemical segment.

headline: Bliss GVS Pharma sees ₹136.70 crore NSE block trade
summary: A block trade of approximately 1,859,916 shares of Bliss GVS Pharma was executed on the NSE at ₹735.00 per share, totalling ₹136.70 crore.

headline: Ajanta Pharma promoter releases pledge on shares
summary: Aayush Agrawal released pledge on 98,185 equity shares of Ajanta Pharma for loan repayment. Post-event encumbered holding stands at 9.32% of total share capital.
